description:
Monitored 150+ production applications using Grafana and Prometheus dashboards for real time observability, proactively identifying and resolving performance and availability issues before end-user impact.
Automated repetitive troubleshooting, health checks, and reporting workflows using Python and Bash scripting, cutting manual triage effort by an estimated 30% and standardizing incident response across the team.
Automated instance configuration, OS level patch management, and firewall/CIDR-scoped access provisioning across 80+ AWS and Azure servers using Ansible playbooks - cutting manual configuration time by an estimated 35% and reducing environment-related incidents by an estimated 20% by resolving multi-region connectivity issues.
Led resolution of 35+ P1/P2 escalated incidents, including a critical production printing outage - ran root cause analysis, restarted failed services, and partnered with the application vendor, driving recurrence to zero over 6 months.
Managed 20-30+ ServiceNow tickets daily across a 24/7 global support model while owning configuration, license renewal, and version upgrade management for 150+ applications, maintaining 98% SLA compliance and audit-ready deployments.
